doc.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

title: Singing backup for Grand Funk Railroad
summary: She was a Funkette backup singer in her mid-20s, learning parts by ear.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Yeah. So that was really fun. I was a Funkette.
Yeah. In fishnet hose and a leotard and everything.
How did those vocal parts get worked out? How many back-up singers were there?
Just two, so you sort of did it by ear or did you have a producer involved?
